figure_four.what: The figure-four stretch, lying on the back.
figure_four.view: Seen from the side and a little above, the figure's head to the right. The near leg is the crossed one.
frames: lying on the back, head and shoulders on the floor; the far knee bent with its foot flat on the floor; the near leg lifted, its ankle resting across the far thigh just above the knee, the near knee falling wide open to the side, so the two legs clearly make the shape of a 4.

the far foot lifted off the floor; the near hand threaded through the gap between the legs and the far hand round the outside, both hands clasped behind the far thigh, gently pulling it towards the chest; the near ankle still resting on the far thigh, the near knee still open wide; head and shoulders on the floor.

seated_hamstring.what: The seated hamstring stretch, one leg at a time.
seated_hamstring.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right. The straight leg is the near leg, reaching to the right.
frames: sitting on the floor, the near leg straight out in front, toes up; the far knee bent with its foot against the inside of the straight thigh; back straight and tall, hands resting on the thighs.
hinging forward from the hips over the straight leg with a long flat back, hands reaching along the shin toward the ankle; the straight leg stays straight.

forward_fold.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: feet hip-width apart, knees soft, arms reaching up overhead, body long.
folded forward from the hips, upper body hanging down in front of the legs, head and arms hanging loose toward the floor, knees softly bent.

supine_twist.view: Seen from the side and a little above, the figure lying on its back on the floor with its head to the right.
frames: lying flat on the back on the floor, arms out wide on the floor at shoulder height; the far leg lying straight along the floor; the near knee bent and drawn up toward the chest, the near foot off the floor.

still lying on the back, both shoulders flat on the floor, the far arm out wide; the near bent knee taken across the body and down to the floor on the far side, the far hand resting on top of that knee; the head turned toward the near side, away from the knee.

knees_to_chest.what: Knees to chest, lying on the back.
knees_to_chest.view: Seen from the side and a little above, the figure's head to the right.
frames: lying on the back, head resting on the floor, both knees bent and drawn in loosely, hands resting under the knees, arms long.
both knees hugged in close to the chest, hands under the knees, head still resting on the floor, the low back rounding gently.

cat_cow.what: Cat-cow on all fours, one slow breath per position.
cat_cow.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: on hands and knees, hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips; the belly sinks toward the floor so the back curves down, chest forward, head lifted to look ahead.
same hands and knees, the back rounded high up toward the ceiling like an angry cat, the head dropped down between the arms, chin toward the chest.

childs_pose.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: kneeling with big toes together and knees apart, sitting on the heels, body upright, hands resting on the thighs.
the hips sunk back onto the heels, the body folded forward between the knees, the forehead resting on the floor, both arms stretched long on the floor in front.

chest_opener.what: The chest and shoulder opener with a stick.
chest_opener.view: Seen at three-quarters from the figure's right side and a little in front, so the stick moving from over the head to behind the back clearly shows.
frames: standing tall, both hands holding the long wooden stick far wider than the shoulders, arms straight, the stick raised straight up above the head.

arms still straight and wide, the stick carried over and back in a big arc until it rests behind the body against the bottom, the chest open and proud; the body stays upright, the arms straight the whole way.
chest_opener.props: a long thin light-wood stick, about 1.5 m long, clearly visible, held in both hands

band_external_rotation.what: Band external rotation, standing side-on to the band.
band_external_rotation.view: Seen from the front, the figure facing the camera. The band comes in from the left edge of the picture; the figure holds it in the hand on the RIGHT side of the picture, so the band crosses in front of the belly.
frames: standing tall; the arm on the right side of the picture has its elbow bent at a right angle and pinned against the waist, the hand in front of the belly holding the band, which runs across the belly to the left edge.
the same elbow still pinned against the waist; the forearm turned outward so the hand has swung out to the right side of the picture, away from the belly, stretching the band longer across the body.
band_external_rotation.props: a light green resistance band running out of the left edge of the picture

wide_stance.view: Seen from the front at three-quarters, the figure facing to the left of the camera.
frames: standing with the feet very wide apart, about twice the width of the shoulders, toes turned out a little, back upright, the palms pressed together in front of the chest.

a deep wide plié, like a ballet dancer: the same very wide feet, the knees bent deeply and pointing out over the toes so the body sinks low, the back perfectly upright, the palms together in front of the chest.

side_stance.what: The side stance, a sideways lunge stretch.
side_stance.view: Seen from the front, the figure facing the camera.
frames: in a wide stance, feet well apart, toes slightly out, chest up, hands together in front of the chest.

weight shifted far over to the left side, sitting down low into the left leg: the left knee deeply bent so the hips are almost as low as the left knee, the left heel flat; the right leg fully straight out to the side with its heel on the floor and toes pointing up; chest up, back straight, palms together in front of the chest.

leg_swing.view: Seen at three-quarters from the front and the figure's right side, the figure standing side-on to a wall on its left.
frames: standing tall side-on to the wall, the LEFT hand resting flat on the wall at shoulder height with the arm out to the side, NOT reaching back; the right hand on the hip; the right leg swung back behind the body, straight and loose.
the right leg swung forward and up in front to about hip height, straight and loose; the left hand still flat on the wall beside the shoulder, the body tall and still.
leg_swing.props: a plain white wall on the figure's left side

bodyweight_squat.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: standing tall, feet shoulder-width, arms out straight in front at shoulder height.
squatted down deep, hips back and down below the knees, chest up, heels flat, arms still out in front for balance.

scapular_pushup.what: The scapular push-up: arms stay straight, only the shoulder blades move.
scapular_pushup.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: in a push-up position on the toes, arms straight, the body one straight line; the chest sinks down between the shoulder blades so the upper back dips.
arms still straight, pushing the floor away so the upper back rounds up a little between the shoulders; the body otherwise one straight line.

thread_needle.what: Thread the needle, on hands and knees.
thread_needle.view: Seen straight from the front, a little above, the figure on hands and knees with its head towards the camera, so an arm crossing sideways under the chest is clearly visible.
frames: on hands and knees on the floor, knees under the hips, back flat; the LEFT hand planted flat on the floor under the left shoulder, arm straight; the RIGHT arm raised straight up to the ceiling, full length, the chest turned open to the right, the head turned to look up at the right hand.

the LEFT hand still planted flat on the floor exactly where it was, the left elbow bent. The RIGHT arm has come down and is threaded UNDER the chest, passing sideways BENEATH the body from the right side to the left side, palm facing up, the back of the right hand and forearm lying on the floor beyond the left hand, so the right arm is clearly seen crossing under the body. The right shoulder and the right side of the head (the right cheek) rest on the floor, the face turned towards the camera. The hips stay high, right above the knees. The head is turned down so only the smooth top and back of the head show: no eyes, no smile. (The face was smoothed out by hand on 2026-11-21: Codex blocks this edit.)

downward_dog.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure head to the left.
frames: on hands and knees, hands a little in front of the shoulders, knees under the hips, back flat, toes tucked under.

hips lifted up and back so the body makes an upside-down V, arms and back in one straight line, legs straight, heels sinking towards the floor. The head hangs relaxed between the upper arms, so the head is UPSIDE DOWN: on the face, the two dot eyes are near the BOTTOM of the head (towards the floor) and the small smile is ABOVE the eyes. The face looks back towards the feet.

low_lunge.what: The low lunge hip flexor stretch.
low_lunge.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: the front foot forward with its knee bent at a right angle over the ankle, the back knee down on the floor behind, body upright, hands on the front thigh.
the hips sunk forward and down so the front knee moves forward a little and the front of the back hip stretches; chest up and tall, hands resting on the front thigh.

pigeon.view: Seen from the front-left at about 45 degrees, so both legs read clearly.
frames: the front leg bent with its shin lying across the floor in front of the hips, the back leg stretched straight back with its knee and the top of the foot on the floor, hips settled down, body upright, hands on the floor either side.
the same legs; the body folded forward over the front shin, forearms resting on the floor in front, head resting on the stacked hands.

cobra.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: lying face down, legs long, tops of the feet on the floor; hands under the shoulders, elbows bent close in; pressing gently to lift the chest, hips staying on the floor, shoulders down away from the ears.
lying flat face down again, forehead resting on the floor, hands under the shoulders, elbows close in, the whole body relaxed.

knee_circles.view: Seen straight from the front, the figure facing the camera.
frames: standing tall on the left leg facing the camera, hands on the hips; the right knee lifted to hip height pointing STRAIGHT AT THE CAMERA, the thigh level and coming towards us, the shin hanging straight down under the knee.

everything exactly the same — the standing leg, the hands, the body, the camera — except the lifted right leg: its knee now turned out to point STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDE (to the figure's right), the thigh still level at hip height and now seen from the side, the shin hanging down under the knee.

hamstring_bounce.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: standing with feet hip-width, knees a little bent, folded forward from the hips, head and arms hanging, hands at about knee height.
a gentle toe touch: the same bend forward, now with straight legs, the hands hanging down in front of the shins, the head relaxed.

front_kick_swing.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: standing tall, arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, both feet on the floor.
the near leg swung forward and up, straight, to about waist height; the back straight and the upper body tall, arms out.

couch.what: The couch stretch for the front of the hip, against a wall.
couch.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right, the wall behind it at the left.
frames: the back knee down on the floor right against the wall, that shin and the top of the foot running straight up the wall; the front foot flat on the floor ahead with the knee bent at a right angle over the ankle; the body upright and tall, hands resting on the front knee.
couch.props: a plain white wall at the left, meeting the floor

standing_hip_flexor.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right.
frames: a long split stance, front foot flat, back heel lifted; both knees a little bent; the pelvis tucked under and the body upright, shifted forward so the front of the back hip stretches; hands resting on the hips.

calf_wall.what: The calf stretch at a wall.
calf_wall.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing right toward a wall at the right.
frames: both hands flat on the wall at shoulder height, arms almost straight; one foot forward with its knee bent; the other leg well behind, straight, its heel pressed flat to the floor; the body leaning into the wall in one straight line from the back heel to the head.
calf_wall.props: a plain white wall at the right, meeting the floor

lat_wall.what: The lat stretch on a wall.
lat_wall.view: Seen from the front at three-quarters, the figure facing to the left of the camera; the wall at the right edge, its surface the same flat #FCFCFA as the background.
frames: the feet planted together about half a metre out from the wall; the whole body tilted sideways toward the wall like a leaning ladder, its weight resting on the right forearm, which lies flat and vertical against the wall high above the head from elbow to hand; the hips pushed out away from the wall so the body bows into a long C-shaped curve, the right armpit and side opened and stretched; the left hand on the left hip; head relaxed between the arms.
lat_wall.props: a plain white wall at the right edge

cross_body.view: Seen from the front, the figure facing the camera.
frames: standing tall; the right arm straight across the chest at chest height; the left hand holding it just above the elbow and drawing it gently in; both shoulders level and down.

ball_shoulder.what: Ball on the wall, rolling out the front of the shoulder.
ball_shoulder.view: Seen from the side and a little in front, the figure facing a wall at the right.
frames: standing close to the wall, leaning the front of the right shoulder into a tennis ball pressed between the shoulder and the wall; the arm hanging relaxed; the body calm.
ball_shoulder.props: a plain white wall at the right and one bright yellow tennis ball between the shoulder and the wall

arm_circles.view: Seen from the front, the figure facing the camera.
frames: standing tall, both arms held straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms down, the hands drawing small circles; shoulders relaxed, down away from the ears.

worlds_greatest.what: A gentle mobility move for the hips and upper back.
worlds_greatest.view: Seen from the front at three-quarters, the figure facing to the right of the camera.
frames: a low lunge seen from the front: the front knee bent with the foot flat on the floor, the back leg long behind with the back knee resting on the floor. One hand planted flat on the floor below the shoulder, its arm straight. The other arm reaching straight up to the ceiling, long and full length, the chest turned open to the side, the head turned to look up at the raised hand.

EXACTLY the same legs as the attached first picture, unchanged: the LEFT knee resting on the floor with the left leg long behind, the RIGHT leg bent in front with the right foot flat on the floor. The same planted hand, the same camera. ONLY the arms and head change: the raised arm comes down and threads under the chest towards the planted hand, its hand resting on the floor beyond the planted wrist, the shoulders turned down towards the floor, the head down — the arms exactly as in the thread-the-needle reference picture.
worlds_greatest.note: Start drawn from words. Finish: legs locked to the start, arms from our own thread_needle-1.png (photos tripped Codex's filter). Until it passes, the app shows standin/worlds_greatest-1.png (thread_needle-1 reused).

band_pull_apart.view: Seen from the front, the figure facing the camera.
frames: standing tall, both arms straight out in front at shoulder height; each hand is a closed fist wrapped around one end of a light resistance band, the band's ends visibly looped around the hands, the band running between the two fists, slightly slack.

arms still straight and at shoulder height, pulled out wide to the sides; each fist still wrapped around its end of the band, which is now stretched taut across the front of the chest; shoulder blades squeezed together, shoulders down.
band_pull_apart.props: a light green flat resistance band, its ends wrapped around the hands

wall_slide.view: Seen from the front, the figure facing the camera with its back against a wall.
frames: back flat against the wall, feet a step out; the arms against the wall in a W: elbows bent and a little below the shoulders, the backs of the hands on the wall.
back still flat on the wall; the arms slid up the wall into a Y above the head, elbows nearly straight, the backs of the hands still on the wall.
wall_slide.props: a plain white wall behind the figure

prone_y_raise.view: Seen from above and behind at about 45 degrees, the figure lying face down with its head away from the camera, so both arms and the Y shape they make are clearly visible.
frames: lying face down, legs long, forehead just above the floor; both arms reaching forward and out in a wide Y, about 45 degrees apart from the head, resting on the floor, thumbs pointing up. The back of the head faces the camera: NO face is visible at all, the face points down at the floor.

still lying face down, legs and chest on the floor, head in line; both arms in the same wide Y lifted a hand's width off the floor, shoulder blades squeezed together, a small gap of shadow under each arm. The back of the head faces the camera: NO face is visible at all, the face points down at the floor.
